entities.name: Kessla
entities.description: A Sylvok shaman from Temple Might in the Tangle on Mirrodin.

entities.name: Temple Might
entities.description: Kessla's home temple in the Tangle.

entities.name: Camik
entities.description: A man who spoke of strange phenomena tied to the green sun Lyese and was arrested.

entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: Ordered Camik arrested and later led men against Kessla; worked with the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Kio-Father
entities.description: A figure who consoled Kessla and was arrested.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders using the former Tree of Tales as a base.

entities.name: Tree of Tales
entities.description: Tree used as the Phyrexian base.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Prevented Kessla from destroying the tree.

events.summary: Camik rants about strange phenomena tied to Lyese and is arrested on Benzir's orders.
events.quote: The man was soon arrested under the orders of Benzir and imprisoned inside the Temple Might.

events.summary: Kessla is saved from a strange beast by an elf.
events.quote: She would have died if she wasn't saved by an elf .

events.summary: Benzir's men attack Kessla's home and she and Kio-Father are arrested; Kessla is rescued again by an elf.
events.quote: Kessla was dragged into the woods but was again rescued by a dark-haired elf.

events.summary: Kessla learns something is invading Mirrodin and offers her knowledge of artifacts.
events.quote: she answered that she had knowledge of artifacts

events.summary: Kessla joins the elves in an attack on Benzir and the Phyrexians, is stopped by Glissa, and detonates the artifact on herself.
events.quote: Kessla, unable to escape, detonated the artifact on herself.

relations.note: The Phyrexians were now using the Tree as base alongside Benzir.
relations.quote: an attack against Benzir and the Phyrexians
